title: truth.json: the closed answer key of one episode (jury side only)
description: Key order does not matter. Parsed by genesis_audit.truth.parse_truth: our loader refuses unknown keys when strict and ignores them (with an evaluator-log warning) on the jury path. An empty issues list is a clean episode.

issue_id.description: Unique within the file. Matching ties are broken by issue_id in Unicode code-point order. Never shown to a policy.

type.description: duplicate_invoice, payment_allocation, fx_mismatch or cutoff in our episodes.

affected_ids.description: The canonical affected set: invoice_id / payment_id values (see docs/ADAPTER.md).

expected_amount_minor.description: Maps to the finding's claimed_amount_minor; matched within the manifest's tolerance for the currency (0 in our episodes).

acceptable_evidence_sets.description: A finding is a TP only if its evidence_ids include one of these sets in full.
